Stakeholder need: N1 Scattered intake and N2 incomplete information: ask for the same fields every time.
Business rule: Title 5-100, requester 1-60, description 10-2000 characters after trimming; department, priority and category from fixed lists.
Implementation: core.js validateNewRequest; app.js New request dialog

Stakeholder need: N3 Unclear department routing: every request lands with a department from the start.
Business rule: Unique SF- identifier; keeps selected department; starts Open and Unassigned; creation timestamp and first history entry.

Stakeholder need: N4 Missing ownership and N5 repeated follow-ups: a named owner and a visible status.
Business rule: Statuses Open, In progress, Resolved. Owner must belong to the department. Owner required for In progress or Resolved. Reopening allowed.

Stakeholder need: N5 Repeated follow-ups: anyone can see what changed and when.
Business rule: History entry for each meaningful owner or status change. No entry when nothing changes. resolvedAt set on resolve, cleared on reopen, replaced on re-resolve.
Implementation: core.js updateRequest; history list in detail dialog

Stakeholder need: N7 Limited visibility of completed work and N6 inconsistent views.
Business rule: Search ID, title, requester, description, owner. Combine with department, status, priority. Active = Open + In progress. High-priority review excludes Resolved. No-results state with Clear filters.

Stakeholder need: N6 Inconsistent workload reporting: one set of records feeds every number.
Business rule: Metrics computed from the same records as the directory. Empty dataset gives zeros, a null average and no division error.
Implementation: core.js computeMetrics; Overview and Analytics views

Stakeholder need: Keep the demonstration usable between visits without a server.
Business rule: Save to localStorage; validate on load; warn on missing, unreadable or full storage; keep working in memory; offer CSV export; explain the browser-and-origin limit.
Implementation: core.js parseSaved, validateAll; app.js load, persist
Release disposition: Verified (automated); real quota exhaustion not tested

Stakeholder need: Let leaders take the data into a spreadsheet.
Business rule: CSV of all current records; quotes escaped; leading = + - @ tab and CR neutralized in every text cell. Download tested separately from generation.

Stakeholder need: Usable on a laptop and a phone, with keyboard access.
Business rule: Responsive layouts, labeled inputs, visible focus, semantic navigation, text labels with status colors. No conformance claim.
Release disposition: Partly verified: automated checks only, no conformance audit, Chromium only

Stakeholder need: Show how the need became a release.
Business rule: Linked requirements, backlog, designs, source, test evidence, deployment configuration and handover.
Implementation: dist/delivery artifacts; Delivery case study view
Test evidence: S01 to S10 static checks; B17
